findingClass: a child row in financial_statements / promoters / ipo_intermediaries / peer_companies carries no field_sources entry for its own row_key — either because provenance was written under the '' catch-all default (a fact from FY2023 is recorded against the same key as FY2024 and the second write silently overwrites the first) or because a writer wrote field_sources rows that are ALL unresolved ('') for a pair it touched. Nothing in the schema stops the '' default — it is a legal row_key — so only an independent read can see either shape of the defect. Single-row pairs are in scope too (F-101, 2026-09-11): a lone child row with an unresolved key is exactly as un-provenanced as one of five.
sourceTask: item 1 slice s8 (docs/design/build-cards/item-01-child-table-consolidated-writer.md); F-101 (2026-09-11) closed the UNVERIFIABLE hole and widened scope to single-row pairs
failThreshold: any (ipo_id, table_name) pair in one of the four child tables that HAS AT LEAST ONE field_sources row (any row_key value, including all-'' ) where at least one derived child row key has no matching field_sources row — this now includes a pair whose field_sources rows are ALL '' (an all-empty-key writer output is a detectable defect, not an unknowable state) and single-row pairs
unverifiableWhen: the (ipo, table) pair has NO field_sources rows at all — no writer has ever touched it, so per-row provenance cannot be judged. Distinct from (and narrower than, since F-101) a pair whose field_sources rows exist but are all unresolved ('' key), which now FAILs rather than reading UNVERIFIABLE. Also UNVERIFIABLE when the child tables or field_sources are unreadable.
note: The enforcement switch is automatic and PER PAIR — the moment field_sources holds ANY row for a pair (real key or all-'' ), that pair is judged for real; there is no flag to flip. Row keys are derived from each child row's OWN identity columns (fiscal_year:basis; normalized promoter name; role:normalized name; normalized peer company name — the item-01 card's row-key table), never from the denormalized normalized_name column the path under audit wrote. Distinct from d_segment_provenance (one field on the singleton ipos row) and p_document_provenance_share (a source-mix ratio): this is the only check that asserts provenance exists PER CHILD ROW. Named residual limit: a writer that lands and writes NO field_sources rows at all leaves every pair UNVERIFIABLE forever, so this check pages P2 nightly rather than FAILs — loud, not silent, but the writer slice's own row-key round-trip test is the hard gate for that case. F-101 (2026-09-11) fixed the prior hole where a writer that wrote ALL-empty-key provenance rows (rather than none at all) was indistinguishable from a writer that had never run — both read as UNVERIFIABLE and could never FAIL.
